SELECT 
  c.headct,
  pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from' as offered_from,
  pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value' as prev_value,
  ROUND(CAST(
    ((REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric - 
      REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::numeric) / 
     REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::numeric * 100) AS numeric), 2
  ) as wdr
FROM cases c 
JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey 
JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wagetrack = pw.trackno 
WHERE c.soccd = '15-1253.00'
LIMIT 10;

WITH qa_wages AS (
  SELECT 
    c.headct,
    ROUND(CAST(
      ((REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric - 
        REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::numeric) / 
       REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::numeric * 100) AS numeric), 2
    ) as wdr
  FROM cases c 
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey 
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wagetrack = pw.trackno 
  WHERE c.soccd = '15-1253.00'
),
qa_tiers AS (
  SELECT 
    headct,
    CASE 
      WHEN wdr < 0 THEN 'Below-Market'
      WHEN wdr >= 0 AND wdr <= 10 THEN 'Market-Competitive'
      ELSE 'Premium'
    END as wage_level
  FROM qa_wages
)
SELECT 
  wage_level,
  SUM(headct) as total_positions,
  COUNT(*) as occurrence_count
FROM qa_tiers
GROUP BY wage_level
ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC;

WITH qa_wages AS (
  SELECT 
    c.soccd,
    c.soctitle,
    c.headct,
    ROUND(CAST(
      ((REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '$', ''), ',', '')::numeric - 
        REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::numeric) / 
       REPLACE(REPLACE(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')::numeric * 100) AS numeric), 2
    ) as wdr
  FROM cases c 
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey 
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON cw.wagetrack = pw.trackno 
  WHERE c.soccd IN ('15-1253.00', '29-1141.00')
    AND pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'
    AND pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit' = 'Year'
),
qa_tiers AS (
  SELECT 
    soccd,
    soctitle,
    headct,
    CASE 
      WHEN wdr < 0 THEN 'Below-Market'
      WHEN wdr >= 0 AND wdr <= 10 THEN 'Market-Competitive'
      ELSE 'Premium'
    END as wage_level
  FROM qa_wages
),
totals_by_occ AS (
  SELECT soccd, SUM(headct) as total_occ_positions
  FROM qa_tiers
  GROUP BY soccd
)
SELECT 
  qt.soctitle,
  qt.wage_level,
  SUM(qt.headct) as total_positions,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(qt.headct) AS numeric) / CAST(tot.total_occ_positions AS numeric) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM qa_tiers qt
JOIN totals_by_occ tot ON qt.soccd = tot.soccd
GROUP BY qt.soccd, qt.soctitle, qt.wage_level, tot.total_occ_positions
ORDER BY qt.soctitle, total_positions DESC;
